overall_assessment: The credential handling, local secret injection, and endpoint validation mechanisms satisfy rigorous security standards. The plan_request implementation forbids HTTP endpoints, blocks credentials in URL authority components (username/password), validates allowed host allowlists, and never prints, logs, or stores secret keys. Secret scanning checks pass across the entire git commit history with zero detected leaks.

findings.description: plan_request strictly validates that endpoint URLs use https scheme and reject embedded username or password credentials.
findings.recommendation: Maintain scheme and host allowlist enforcement in all adapter invocations.

findings.description: Local credential presence is evaluated as a boolean indicator without reading or reflecting credential bytes in diagnostic outputs.
findings.recommendation: Retain this redacted pattern for all runtime execution adapters.

findings.description: Environment variable names adhere strictly to canonical [A-Z0-9_]+ conventions, preventing injection vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Enforce variable name regex in automated repository validations.

calibration_notes: Security auditors confirm that credential redaction and local-only injection controls prevent data leakage and comply with zero-trust principles.
